# Oracle Requirements Checklist: Independent MachineEffects Oracle

**Purpose**: Review whether the independent-oracle requirements are complete, clear, measurable,
and safe to implement without promoting production self-agreement to semantic truth.
**Created**: 2026-08-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact.
Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is
satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Independence and Authority

- [ ] CHK001 Are the production evaluator and expected tables explicitly described as comparison subjects rather than oracle authorities? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the distinction between ISA/specification, independent execution/reference, compiler, Ghidra, and Capstone authority roles unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the specification define how an oracle identity is proven distinct from the production evaluator? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the deterministic add counterexample state the pre-implementation failure and the evidence required for later acceptance? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001, SC-001]

## State and Defined-Bit Semantics

- [ ] CHK005 Are instruction bytes, initial state, expected outcome, profile, feature set, and defined mask all required for each corpus case? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the shape and width relationship between each observable and its comparison mask explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification explain how undefined, unpredictable, unobserved, trap, fault, and exception outcomes remain explicit? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Is equivalent representation distinguished from an exact bit-for-bit match with an auditable rule? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]

## Fail-Closed and Uncertainty Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Are all required negative classes named with a clear rejection or blocking outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the specification prohibit partial acceptance of malformed, truncated, inconsistent, or digest-mismatched artifacts? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Are unavailable, unsupported, not-integrated, cancelled, and resource-limited states separately represented and excluded from pass counts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, FR-013]
- [ ] CHK012 Are bounded diagnostics and cancellation outcomes measurable without implying a false pass? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-013, SC-008]

## Identity, Replay, and Release Evidence

- [ ] CHK013 Does the case identity include all fields whose change would invalidate expected state or comparison semantics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the two-run deterministic replay requirements precise about unchanged corpus, oracle, verifier, and toolchain identities? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the report list every required product, base/candidate-tree, verifier, corpus, oracle, and toolchain identity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, FR-017]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the release requirement explicitly reject stale evidence from an old head, verifier, corpus, oracle, or merge tree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, SC-007]
- [ ] CHK017 Are exact-head proof and candidate-merge-tree proof defined as separate acceptance obligations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, SC-010]

## Coverage, Denominator, and Scope Boundaries

- [ ] CHK018 Is the v1 architecture/profile inventory enumerated without implying full ISA coverage? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the specification require real ISA or independent authority evidence for promoted profiles while preserving explicit gaps? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK020 Are A2 production-registry declarations and independent semantic results kept as separate authority classes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Are denominator IDs, rows, counts, and digest protected from deletion, rewriting, or silent promotion? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Are forbidden production, downstream, C0-01, workflow, and generated-output changes stated as scope boundaries rather than implied assumptions? [Scope, Spec §FR-016, SC-009]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK023 Are required ISA/specification, hardware/emulator/reference, compiler/toolchain, and host-feature dependencies identified with explicit unavailable behavior? [Dependency, Spec §FR-012, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the offline-only default and any network-dependent exception clearly bounded and identity-recorded? [Constraint, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK025 Does the specification identify Sol's integration ownership for moving main, generated output, exact-head gates, and final cutover? [Traceability, Assumptions, Spec §FR-017]

## Notes

- Every item evaluates the quality of the written requirements, not implementation behavior.
- Leave all items unchecked until a reviewer confirms the requirement-quality criterion.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` is the separate built-in specification-quality checklist.
